question_text: A scientist performed an experiment to produce hybrid viruses by mixing two different serotypes of influenza virus, H1N1 and H2N2, in a respiratory epithelium cell line. Several days later, the scientist collected the media and analyzed the viral progeny. She found the following serotypes of virus: H1N1, H2N2, H1N2, and H2N1. Which of the following terms best explains the appearance of new serotypes?
